note: The negative control, as data. Each entry breaks the exact behaviour one contract row claims to check; the row must go red, and go green again on revert. An assertion never observed failing has not been shown to test anything (Part C, Track 4). Every `find` string was grepped against the working tree, not written from memory.
howToAdd: Pick a row. Find the ONE line that, changed, should make it fail. Prefer a constant over logic — a mutation that breaks the build proves nothing. Then run it: if the row stays green, you have found a vacuous assertion, which is the more valuable outcome.
